what: A full-width video/photo band shrinks, scrubbed to scroll (scrub .8), from when the panel’s top edge hits 20% of the screen until its bottom edge reaches screen center. It narrows to the body column width while its corners round from 0 → 1rem — the hero showreel settling down to the size of the cards in the work list below

options.to: Element to measure the shrink width from (selector, e.g. .wrap). If none, panel width − side insets
options.inset: side margin (px) when there is no to, default 48
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Shrinking cell (child) — video and photo inside fill the cell (object-fit: cover)

from.where: index.js .reel__layout (Hero showreel — top 20% → bottom 50%, scrub .8, container width·1rem)
